query: WITH p2025_arc AS (SELECT id FROM public.story_arcs WHERE slug = 'project-2025-doj-track1-implementation'), epstein_arc AS (SELECT id FROM public.story_arcs WHERE slug = 'epstein-files-act-process-oversight'), epstein_policy AS (SELECT id FROM public.p3_policy WHERE name = 'Epstein Files Transparency Act — disclosure-process compliance') SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.articles) AS total_articles, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.articles WHERE arc_id = (SELECT id FROM p2025_arc)) AS p2025_arc_articles, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.articles WHERE ingestion_run_id = 'v2-p2025-corpus-2026-08-19') AS p2025_source_mapped_articles, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.story_arcs WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM p2025_arc UNION ALL SELECT id FROM epstein_arc)) AS expansion_arcs, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.arc_events WHERE arc_id = (SELECT id FROM p2025_arc)) AS p2025_arc_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.arc_events WHERE arc_id = (SELECT id FROM epstein_arc)) AS epstein_arc_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.nodes WHERE metadata ->> 'manifest' = 'v2-p2025-corpus-2026-08-19') AS p2025_graph_nodes, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.edges WHERE metadata ->> 'manifest' = 'v2-p2025-corpus-2026-08-19') AS p2025_graph_edges, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.nodes WHERE metadata ->> 'manifest' = 'v2-epstein-process-cross-surface-2026-08-19') AS epstein_graph_nodes, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.edges WHERE metadata ->> 'manifest' = 'v2-epstein-process-cross-surface-2026-08-19') AS epstein_graph_edges, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.p3_policy WHERE agency = 'DOJ' AND name LIKE 'P2025-T1-G%') AS p2025_policy_objectives, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.p3_policy_track_event WHERE method_version = 'p2025-track1-stageC-v1') AS p2025_stated_objective_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.p3_policy_track_event WHERE method_version = 'p2025-track1-stageE-v1') AS p2025_outcome_or_gap_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.p3_policy_track_event WHERE policy_id = (SELECT id FROM epstein_policy) AND method_version = 'epstein-compliance-process-v2') AS epstein_policy_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.events WHERE rule_version = 'v2-p2025-source-comparison-2026-08-19') AS p2025_comparison_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.explanations WHERE rule_version = 'sc-v1|v2-p2025-source-comparison-2026-08-19' AND is_current = true) AS p2025_comparison_explanations, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.events WHERE rule_version = 'v2-epstein-process-2026-08-19') AS epstein_comparison_events, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.explanations WHERE rule_version = 'sc-v1|v2-epstein-process-2026-08-19' AND is_current = true) AS epstein_comparison_explanations LIMIT 1;
